title: JA Morgan wp7 1.1.10: the theme is listed in WordPress as "WP Morgan" and the release records a passing site sweep on the released zip
steps: S1: Read packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/wp-ja-morgan/style.css and overlays/wp-ja-morgan/style.css and theme.config.json.
S2: Read tasks/ja-morgan-wp7/release/fix-measure.json (taken by site-sweep.mjs on the released zip) and the zip's line in tasks/ja-morgan-wp7/release/SHA256SUMS.
expect: S1: both style.css files have exactly one 'Theme Name: WP Morgan' line; the shipped style.css has one 'Version: 1.1.10' line and the overlay's theme.config.json version is 1.1.10.
S2: fix-measure.json names site-sweep.mjs, its themeZipSha256 equals the zip line of SHA256SUMS, and 11 of 11 checks pass with none failing.
evidence: Name-only release of 06/10/2026: the clean restore of 1.1.10 passes 11/11 sweep checks on the released zip; `wp theme list` on the restore shows wp-ja-morgan titled WP Morgan at 1.1.10.
fence: Reads committed files only; it does not re-measure a browser. The recorded sweep is bound to the released zip by its sha256.
